description: Full-featured Notion-style block editor. Supports 20+ block types (paragraphs, headings, lists, code, callouts, toggles, columns, images, video, PDF, file, equation, bookmark, embed, database, diagram, wireframe, spreadsheet), drag-and-drop reordering, slash menu (/), inline formatting toolbar, @@ mentions, [[ page links, {{ token variables, multi-page sidebar navigation, real-time collaboration, comments, page history, import/export, and full keyboard support.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Core page data provider — lists, loads, creates and deletes pages.

parameters.name: AggregateProvider
parameters.description: Canonical page aggregate provider for all block reads and validated save-once mutations, including optimistic conflict recovery.

parameters.name: SearchProvider
parameters.description: Enables the Ctrl+P full-screen page search dialog and [[ page link autocomplete.

parameters.name: DatabaseProvider
parameters.description: Enables inline database blocks (table, board, list, gallery, calendar, timeline views).

parameters.name: CommentProvider
parameters.description: Enables block-level and text-anchor comments with threads and reactions through the shared comment provider.

parameters.name: HistoryProvider
parameters.description: Enables page version history with diff view and restore.

parameters.name: AuditProvider
parameters.description: Enables workspace activity/audit log queries through the shared activity provider.

parameters.name: CollaborationProvider
parameters.description: Enables real-time collaboration — live cursor presence and remote block sync.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Enables @@ user mentions through the shared people provider.

parameters.name: BookmarkProvider
parameters.description: Enables bookmark blocks that fetch Open Graph metadata from URLs.

parameters.name: FileProvider
parameters.description: Enables file upload for image, PDF, audio, and file blocks via drag-and-drop or the Upload tab.

parameters.name: MediaLibraryProvider
parameters.description: Enables a media library tab in the upload dialog — browse and select previously uploaded files.

parameters.name: TokenProvider
parameters.description: Enables {{ token autocomplete. Type {{ in any text block to open the token dropdown and insert a variable chip.

parameters.name: ImportExportProvider
parameters.description: Enables Markdown/HTML import and export via Page Settings.

parameters.name: DiagramDocumentProvider
parameters.description: Enables diagram blocks with a full-screen diagram editor.

parameters.name: WireframeDocumentProvider
parameters.description: Enables wireframe blocks with a full-screen wireframe editor.

parameters.name: SpreadsheetDocumentProvider
parameters.description: Enables spreadsheet blocks embedded in the page.

parameters.name: SyncedBlockProvider
parameters.description: Enables synced block support — blocks shared across multiple pages.

parameters.name: AllowedBlockTypes
parameters.description: When non-null, restricts the slash menu and Turn Into menu to only these block types. Existing blocks of other types are still displayed. When null, all types are available.

parameters.name: InitialPageId
parameters.description: Page ID to open on first render. Supports @bind-InitialPageId.

parameters.name: ShowSidebar
parameters.description: Show the left navigation sidebar.

parameters.name: SinglePageMode
parameters.description: Renders the editor as a self-contained single-page surface (e.g. a work-item description field). Always hides the sidebar (ignoring ShowSidebar); disables in-editor navigation, breadcrumbs/back, space selector, template gallery, child-page creation and the tasks/blog/analytics/audit panels; removes multi-page blocks (child page, linked page/database, include page, children display, content-by-label, breadcrumb) from the slash and Turn Into menus; and delegates navigation to other pages to OnPageNavigationRequested. Requires InitialPageId.

parameters.name: OnPageNavigationRequested
parameters.description: Raised in SinglePageMode when navigation to a page other than InitialPageId is requested (e.g. clicking a link). The host decides where it opens; the editor stays on the initial page. Arg = requested page ID.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Prevents all editing interactions.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Explicit current user identifier for collaboration, reactions, and user-scoped actions. When blank, the editor resolves ITmCurrentUser from DI and falls back to demo.

parameters.name: CurrentUserGroupIds
parameters.description: Group identifiers used for permission checks for the current user.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the root element.

parameters.name: OnPageChanged
parameters.description: Raised whenever the active page changes.

parameters.name: OnTrashRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests to open the trash panel from the sidebar.

parameters.name: OnCreateTokenRequested
parameters.type: Func<string, Task<(string Key, string DisplayName, string? ColorClass)?>?>?
parameters.description: Called when the user clicks "Create token" in the token dropdown. Arg = current search query (may be empty). Return the newly created token (Key, DisplayName, ColorClass) so the editor can insert it automatically, or null if the user cancelled.

publicMethods.name: NavigateToPageAsync

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: ID of the page to navigate to.

publicMethods.description: Programmatically navigates to a page and pushes it onto the internal navigation stack. Calling with the current page ID is a no-op.

usedAbstractions.name: INotionAggregateProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Required — complete page snapshots and atomic block persistence.

usedAbstractions.name: ITokenDataProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Optional — supplies token autocomplete items when the user types {{.

usedAbstractions.name: ITmFileProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Optional — enables file/image upload via drag-and-drop and the Upload tab.

usedAbstractions.name: INotionMediaLibraryProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Optional — enables media library browsing in the upload dialog.

usedAbstractions.name: ITmPeopleProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Optional — enables @@ user mention autocomplete through the shared people provider.

usedAbstractions.name: ITmCommentProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Optional — enables block and text-anchor comments through the shared comment provider.
